@concat('"WITH LOAD_ERR
     AS (SELECT                                              
                DISTINCT
                A.ID AS ID1,
                D.ID AS ID2,
                TO_DATE (''"', string(variables('BatchDate')), '"'',
                         ''mm/dd/yyyy'')
                   AS RUN_DATE,
                 "', string(variables('BatchId')), '"   AS BATCH_ID,
                A.ERR_DATA AS FACETS_ERROR,
                B.ERR_DATA AS RETURN_CODE,
                C.ERR_DATA AS ERROR_CODE,
                D.ERR_DATA AS ERROR_MESSAGE
           FROM AGP.LOAD_ERR_FILE A
                JOIN AGP.LOAD_ERR_FILE B ON A.ID + 1 = B.ID
                JOIN AGP.LOAD_ERR_FILE C ON A.ID + 2 = C.ID
                JOIN AGP.LOAD_ERR_FILE D ON A.ID + 3 = D.ID
          WHERE A.ERR_DATA LIKE ''Facets - Error:%''
         UNION
         SELECT                                               
                DISTINCT
                A.ID AS ID1,
                D.ID AS ID2,
                TO_DATE (''"', string(variables('BatchDate')), '"'',
                         ''mm/dd/yyyy'')
                   AS RUN_DATE,
                "', string(variables('BatchId')), '"   AS BATCH_ID,
                A.ERR_DATA AS FACETS_ERROR,
                B.ERR_DATA AS RETURN_CODE,
                C.ERR_DATA AS ERROR_CODE,
                D.ERR_DATA AS ERROR_MESSAGE
           FROM AGP.LOAD_ERR_FILE A
                JOIN AGP.LOAD_ERR_FILE B ON A.ID + 1 = B.ID
                JOIN AGP.LOAD_ERR_FILE C ON A.ID + 2 = C.ID
                JOIN AGP.LOAD_ERR_FILE D ON A.ID + 4 = D.ID
          WHERE A.ERR_DATA LIKE ''Facets - Error:%''
         UNION
         SELECT                                               
                DISTINCT
                A.ID AS ID1,
                D.ID AS ID2,
                TO_DATE (''"', string(variables('BatchDate')), '"'',
                         ''mm/dd/yyyy'')
                   AS RUN_DATE,
                "', string(variables('BatchId')), '"   AS BATCH_ID,
                A.ERR_DATA AS FACETS_ERROR,
                B.ERR_DATA AS RETURN_CODE,
                C.ERR_DATA AS ERROR_CODE,
                D.ERR_DATA AS ERROR_MESSAGE
           FROM AGP.LOAD_ERR_FILE A
                JOIN AGP.LOAD_ERR_FILE B ON A.ID + 1 = B.ID
                JOIN AGP.LOAD_ERR_FILE C ON A.ID + 2 = C.ID
                JOIN AGP.LOAD_ERR_FILE D ON A.ID + 5 = D.ID
          WHERE A.ERR_DATA LIKE ''Facets - Error:%''
         UNION
         SELECT                                               
                DISTINCT
                A.ID AS ID1,
                D.ID AS ID2,
                TO_DATE (''"', string(variables('BatchDate')), '"'',
                         ''mm/dd/yyyy'')
                   AS RUN_DATE,
                "', string(variables('BatchId')), '"   AS BATCH_ID,
                A.ERR_DATA AS FACETS_ERROR,
                B.ERR_DATA AS RETURN_CODE,
                C.ERR_DATA AS ERROR_CODE,
                D.ERR_DATA AS ERROR_MESSAGE
           FROM AGP.LOAD_ERR_FILE A
                JOIN AGP.LOAD_ERR_FILE B ON A.ID + 1 = B.ID
                JOIN AGP.LOAD_ERR_FILE C ON A.ID + 2 = C.ID
                JOIN AGP.LOAD_ERR_FILE D ON A.ID + 6 = D.ID
          WHERE A.ERR_DATA LIKE ''Facets - Error:%''
         UNION
         SELECT                                             
                DISTINCT
                A.ID AS ID1,
                D.ID AS ID2,
                TO_DATE (''"', string(variables('BatchDate')), '"'',
                         ''mm/dd/yyyy'')
                   AS RUN_DATE,
                "', string(variables('BatchId')), '"  AS BATCH_ID,
                A.ERR_DATA AS FACETS_ERROR,
                B.ERR_DATA AS RETURN_CODE,
                C.ERR_DATA AS ERROR_CODE,
                D.ERR_DATA AS ERROR_MESSAGE
           FROM AGP.LOAD_ERR_FILE A
                JOIN AGP.LOAD_ERR_FILE B ON A.ID + 1 = B.ID
                JOIN AGP.LOAD_ERR_FILE C ON A.ID + 2 = C.ID
                JOIN AGP.LOAD_ERR_FILE D ON A.ID + 7 = D.ID
          WHERE A.ERR_DATA LIKE ''Facets - Error:%''
         UNION
         SELECT                                              
                DISTINCT
                A.ID AS ID1,
                D.ID AS ID2,
                TO_DATE (''"', string(variables('BatchDate')), '"'',
                         ''mm/dd/yyyy'')
                   AS RUN_DATE,
                "', string(variables('BatchId')), '"   AS BATCH_ID,
                A.ERR_DATA AS FACETS_ERROR,
                B.ERR_DATA AS RETURN_CODE,
                C.ERR_DATA AS ERROR_CODE,
                D.ERR_DATA AS ERROR_MESSAGE
           FROM AGP.LOAD_ERR_FILE A
                JOIN AGP.LOAD_ERR_FILE B ON A.ID + 1 = B.ID
                JOIN AGP.LOAD_ERR_FILE C ON A.ID + 2 = C.ID
                JOIN AGP.LOAD_ERR_FILE D ON A.ID + 8 = D.ID
          WHERE A.ERR_DATA LIKE ''Facets - Error:%''
         UNION
         SELECT                                               
                DISTINCT
                A.ID AS ID1,
                D.ID AS ID2,
                TO_DATE (''"', string(variables('BatchDate')), '"'',
                         ''mm/dd/yyyy'')
                   AS RUN_DATE,
                "', string(variables('BatchId')), '"  AS BATCH_ID,
                A.ERR_DATA AS FACETS_ERROR,
                B.ERR_DATA AS RETURN_CODE,
                C.ERR_DATA AS ERROR_CODE,
                D.ERR_DATA AS ERROR_MESSAGE
           FROM AGP.LOAD_ERR_FILE A
                JOIN AGP.LOAD_ERR_FILE B ON A.ID + 1 = B.ID
                JOIN AGP.LOAD_ERR_FILE C ON A.ID + 2 = C.ID
                JOIN AGP.LOAD_ERR_FILE D ON A.ID + 9 = D.ID
          WHERE A.ERR_DATA LIKE ''Facets - Error:%''
         ORDER BY 1, 2),
     LOAD_LOG
     AS (  SELECT                                          
                 ID1,
                  RUN_DATE,
                  BATCH_ID,
                  FACETS_ERROR,
                  RETURN_CODE,
                  ERROR_CODE,
                  LISTAGG (ERROR_MESSAGE, '' '') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ID2)
                     AS ERROR_MESSAGE
             FROM LOAD_ERR
         GROUP BY ID1,
                  RUN_DATE,
                  FACETS_ERROR,
                  RETURN_CODE,
                  ERROR_CODE,
                  BATCH_ID)
SELECT                                                       
      ID1,
       RUN_DATE,
       FACETS_ERROR,
       RETURN_CODE,
       ERROR_CODE,
       CASE
          WHEN SUBSTR (ERROR_MESSAGE,
                       1,
                       (INSTR (ERROR_MESSAGE, ''Solution:'', 1)) - 1)
                  IS NULL
          THEN
             ERROR_MESSAGE
          ELSE
             SUBSTR (ERROR_MESSAGE,
                     1,
                     (INSTR (ERROR_MESSAGE, ''Solution:'', 1)) - 1)
       END
          AS ERR_MESSAGE,
       BATCH_ID
  FROM LOAD_LOG"')
